questionText: Firm XYZ-13 has two partners A and B with capitals of Rs. 640,000 and Rs. 320,000. Partnership deed provides for interest on capital @ 8% p.a. Net profit before interest for the year ended 31st March is Rs. 101,800. The interest on capital credited to A and B will be:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT concept for Interest on Capital: Sufficient Profits.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Accounting for Partnership (Interest on Capital: Sufficient Profits):
Rs. 51,200 and Rs. 25,600 respectively

Detailed Context:
1. Total profit available (Rs. 101,800) exceeds total interest on capital required (Rs. 76,800).
2. Therefore, full interest on capital is credited to partners: Rs. 51,200 and Rs. 25,600 respectively.
Hence Option D is correct.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match List-I with List-II
List-I
List-II
(A) Existing Goodwill
(I) No entry passed.
(B) Goodwill Premium
(II) Calculated on the basis of capital of
partners.
(C) Goodwill Paid
Privately
(III) Written off.
(D) Hidden Goodwill
(IV) Credited to sacrificing partner.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. (A) Existing Goodwill: Written off among old partners in old ratio -> (III).
2. (B) Goodwill Premium: Credited to sacrificing partners in sacrificing ratio -> (IV).
3. (C) Goodwill Paid Privately: No entry passed in firm's books -> (I).
4. (D) Hidden Goodwill: Calculated on the basis of capital of partners -> (II).
5. Correct matching: (A)-(III), (B)-(IV), (C)-(I), (D)-(II).
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.
